description: A dim, painterly interior. A middle-aged man with short dark hair, in a dark button-up work shirt with rolled sleeves and trousers, stands bent over a large drum-like reel wound with coiled tubing, set in a silver metal frame on a wooden pedestal, with a hose hanging to the floor. Behind him is an iron-frame bed with a figure under a blanket, wooden cabinets, and shelves with glass flasks. Clothing, bed and machine suggest the mid-20th century. No letters or numbers; a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner. Painting fills the image edge to edge; nothing gory or nude.
reason: Shows a 20th-century man tending a tube-wound drum machine beside a hospital-style iron bed, not Pascal and Fermat's 1654 letters on probability.
